theorem.finite_atlas: compact robust public basins admit a finite read-labeled connector subcover
theorem.safe_reset: propagated error stays below safety margin and terminal reset margin
theorem.v33_implication: a finite fixed-reset atlas supplies constant safe-closing certificates
theorem.v34_boundary: the literal v0.34 local premise needs an all-pairs atlas; a fixed-reset atlas only supplies its safe-closing conclusion
theorem.coordinate_invariance: registered bi-Lipschitz conjugacies preserve atlas existence but need not preserve numerical radii

disposition: robust finite-cost public connector atlases are now constructed from registered Lipschitz margins and observation/action quantization; proving such robust pointwise connectors for the full canonical normally hyperbolic class remains open
